faq_heading: New Westminster penthouses: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in New Westminster?
faq.a: The 53 penthouses that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $745,000, with the middle half between $515,800 and $963,900. All New Westminster condos had a median of $570,000.

faq.q: How does a New Westminster penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 31% more at the median, or $629 a square foot against $626 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do New Westminster penthouses sell?
faq.a: 39 days at a median, closing at 97.3% of list, with 6% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in New Westminster?
faq.a: 53 of the 624 New Westminster condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Queensborough (13 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do New Westminster penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $645 a month for penthouses and $542 for all condos.

This search lists penthouses for sale in New Westminster: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers Downtown, Uptown, Quay, Sapperton and the Brow of the Hill. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

53 New Westminster penthouses sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, out of 624 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $745,000, 31% more than the $570,000 median for all condos, in 39 days at a median.

21% of New Westminster penthouses sold for $1,000,000 or more, compared with 3% of all condos in the same months.
Timber House had the most penthouse sales of any building, with 8 at a median of $959,400, and it was built in 2023.
About buying a top-floor home in New Westminster

New Westminster’s Official Community Plan is “Our City 2041,” Bylaw No. 7925, 2017, and Uptown is a Frequent Transit Development Area, where the City directs higher-density, transit-supportive growth. Zoning is Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001.
Ask what the zoning allows on the sites around the building. A view is only as safe as the neighbouring lots, and a nearby site that can still be built higher can change it.
Before you offer on a New Westminster penthouse

items.t: Before you offer, read the last two years of strata minutes for roof repairs, and ask whether a replacement is scheduled.
Ask the strata for any envelope-repair history, and how the insurance deductible would be split if a leak started above you.
Get the strata plan and confirm the status of any roof space: owned, limited common property or common property.
Ask what is directly above the unit and how the building handles summer heat on the top floor.

Compare the building’s fee with the $645 a month median for New Westminster penthouses and $542 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median New Westminster penthouse sold was built in 2008.
